subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should a CI/security owner approve the new pinned action revisions that execute in workflows with GitHub App private keys, registry credentials, and OpenAI credentials?
rationale: The proposed pins preserve immutability, but selecting revised third-party executable code at secret-bearing workflow boundaries is a repository trust decision that automated review cannot safely substitute.

options.title: Audit and approve the revisions
options.body: Verify the upstream release commits and affected workflow paths, then approve this batch once the secret-bearing action updates are accepted.

options.title: Split the sensitive action updates
options.body: Land only independently approved low-risk workflow-action updates and hold token, publishing, or Codex-related action revisions for separate review.

options.title: Pause this Dependabot batch
options.body: Close or defer the batch if the repository does not want to accept the revised action trust boundary at this time.

recommendation.title: Audit and approve the revisions
recommendation.body: Verify the upstream release commits and affected workflow paths, then approve this batch once the secret-bearing action updates are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied timeline exposes this bot as the only concrete security-routing signal; a human CI/security owner must make the actual approval.
